parameters.jsCode: const ctx=$('Validate TikTok Creator Privacy Options').first().json;const r=items[0].json||{};if(r.error?.code&&r.error.code!=='ok')throw new Error('TikTok init failed: '+r.error.code+' '+String(r.error.message||''));const id=String(r.data?.publish_id||'');if(!id)throw new Error('TikTok did not return publish_id');return [{json:{...ctx,tiktokPublishId:id}}];

const ctx=$('Restore TikTok Context with Publish ID').first().json;const r=items[0].json||{};if(r.error?.code&&r.error.code!=='ok')throw new Error('TikTok status failed: '+r.error.code);const s=String(r.data?.status||'');if(s==='FAILED')throw new Error('TikTok publish failed: '+String(r.data?.fail_reason||'unknown'));if(s!=='PUBLISH_COMPLETE')throw new Error('TikTok is still processing after bounded wait: '+s);return [{json:{...ctx,platform:'tiktok',post_id:(r.data?.publicaly_available_post_id||[]).join(','),publish_id:ctx.tiktokPublishId,status:s}}];
